value.rationale: A payoff-independent structural nonrecurrence theorem adjudicates the interpretation of the same paper’s two asymmetric oscillation examples: both have kappa>0 and cannot be compact interior cycles. It supplies a sharp natural resonance surface and a quantitative directed boundary excursion bound, with a resonant fully interior equilibrium family demonstrating attainability. The result does not claim eventual convergence of a fixed coordinate.
